description: Defines utility functions and classes for high-resolution and approximate timing, including clock measurement and conversion to Unix time, with platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: ApproximateClockToUnixTimeConverter
classes.description: Provides conversion from approximate clock readings to Unix time, with internal measurement and conversion methods.

methods.name: getTimeSinceEpoch
methods.description: Returns current system time in nanoseconds since epoch.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns current time, optionally monotonic, in nanoseconds.

methods.name: getApproximateTime
methods.description: Returns an approximate timestamp, using TSC if available, otherwise falls back to getTime.

methods.name: measurePair
methods.description: Measures a pair of Unix time and approximate clock value for calibration.

methods.name: measurePairs
methods.description: Collects multiple measurement pairs for calibration.

methods.name: makeConverter
methods.description: Creates a function to convert approximate clock readings to Unix time.
